name: Servo Flute GMB
summary: Modular ESP32 controller for robotic flutes and other hole-fingered wind instruments.

notes: Project README recommends an ESP32-WROOM development board for the first build.

transports.notes: Serial MIDI DIN is receive-only on the documented board and cannot answer GMB discovery.

notes: Descriptor is derived from the active validated configuration; HTTP descriptor is also exposed in Wi-Fi mode.

mechanics.summary: Servo fingers close instrument holes while a configurable air-management chain supplies and regulates airflow.
notes: Supports multiple air architectures: solenoid, servo valve, fan, pumps or reservoir systems.

actuators.role: Finger actuation and optional airflow control
actuators.notes: Up to 31 finger servo channels are documented across one or two PCA9685 boards.

actuators.role: Optional pump or reservoir air source

supplies.label: Servo supply
supplies.notes: Dedicated regulated actuator supply; do not power multiple servos from the ESP32 5 V pin.

notes: ESP32, PCA9685 and actuator supply grounds must be common.
Inductive loads require appropriate flyback protection and fused actuator power.

steps: Connect to ServoFlute-Setup on first boot.
Open the captive portal or http://192.168.4.1.
Select an instrument preset, map servos and calibrate finger and airflow values.

warnings: Physical PCA9685, servo, pump, fan, valve, sensor and microphone validation is explicitly still pending in the project documentation.
